info.title: W Monitor Public API
info.description: Independent read-only telemetry receiver. No host-control APIs, update executors or private W Monitor dependencies. Recovery and registration secrets are shown once and persisted only as SHA-256 digests. Monitoring-space management does not operate monitored hosts. Dynamic telemetry lives only in encrypted Redis; SQLite holds durable user/space metadata, credential digests and notification delivery bookkeeping. Missing Redis is unknown, never a SQLite telemetry fallback. AES-GCM addresses are purpose-bound and never replace authentication. The backend negotiates zh-CN/en with Accept-Language and returns Content-Language; unsupported languages fall back to en. User/host text is preserved.

BrowserSession.name: __Host-wm_public
BrowserSession.description: Owner-only, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax browser cookie. Mutations additionally require trusted Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

ReportBearer.description: wmb_ bootstrap registration or sat_ bound telemetry-only machine credential; never a browser/control credential.

OperationToken.name: X-Operation-Token
OperationToken.description: Encrypted manage-purpose token for the current session space. This token alone grants no access.

history_ref.description: Public snapshots only: page-bound encrypted routing reference for historical public metrics.

post.description: Maximum decoded UTF-8 JSON body: 8 MiB. Authorization: Bearer bootstrap or bound machine token. Machine tokens are bound to one space and agent_id. Replies contain scope=telemetry, commands=[], and a bounded report interval; first registration returns a sat_ machine token. No commands, acknowledgements, alternate control transport or update directives are processed. Unsupported delta snapshots request a full report. Additional fields are tolerated. The fixed endpoint routes reports solely by the hashed Bearer credential; URLs never contain tenant credentials. A missing Redis write returns 503 and does not acknowledge the report. Identity and gzip encodings are accepted, both bounded to 8 MiB. Steady-state reports never write SQLite. Compressed Redis snapshots expire after 300 seconds; last-seen metadata remains. Responses include runtime-configured report_interval_ms and metrics_interval_ms. Metrics samples require bound device credentials and update compact Redis metadata only; full diagnostic snapshots retain their own cadence and TTL. Protection is per valid credential, allowing many devices behind one NAT. Replies may include agent_config (AgentConfig schema), limited to realtime_metrics and compress_reports. Agents advertise telemetry.settings=1, telemetry.metrics, telemetry.compression and telemetry.config_revision. Unknown or malformed settings envelopes are ignored by the Agent. Desired preferences are durable; steady-state reports only read their indexed device_settings row and never acquire the SQLite writer lock. Agents1.1.0+ keep an independent Ed25519 seed in owner-only local config and submit X-WM-Public-Key, X-WM-Timestamp (Unix milliseconds), X-WM-Nonce (16-byte lower hex), X-WM-Signature. Sign LF-joined wm-device-v1, fixed origin, POST, /api/v1/report, kind(full/metrics), encoding(identity/gzip), SHA256(bearer token), timestamp, nonce, SHA256(exact wire body). Clock tolerance is300s. Redis atomically requires a strictly increasing signed timestamp per key+credential; one replay slot per device binding expires600s. First valid signed report binds that device key without changing token/identity; thereafter unsigned or different-key reports fail. Unbound legacy devices remain valid. Private keys are never submitted.

post.description: Never receives or returns a private key. Challenge expires after 120 seconds and can be consumed once. Signature message is wm-space-v1 + LF + fixed public origin + LF + purpose + LF + sealed challenge. Proof must match the current browser session. Restore rotates session ID/CSRF. Bind/rotate/claim additionally require the current-space operation token; account claim still requires verified W-ID login. Existing bound keys can change only via explicit recovery rotation/claim.
